notes.title: Game Update v5.1.1
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Tank Battle: Normandy - update v3.1.5
notes.content:
Update: Some German transport vehicles to Sd.Kfz 7's.
Update: The play balance in the 'Surrounded' mission.

notes.title: Tank Battle: Normandy version 3.1.3 update
notes.content: Change: Some improvements to the main map display.

notes.title: Tank Battle: Normandy version 3.1.2 update
notes.content: Change: The terrain image for rocks.  The previous update was not a satisfactory image.

notes.title: Tank Battle: Normandy v3.1.0 update
notes.content:
Change: Reduced the tree density on some map hexes.
Fix: Some terrain was not providing cover against shooting, as per the terrain effects chart.
Fix: Some woodland hexes were incorrectly allowing units to pass through them in a single movement action.
Update: Some game text.

notes.title: Tank Battle: Normandy - version 3.0.3 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Change: The Bonus 'Hit the Beach!' Campaign is now available to all players without requiring an email registration.
[*] Fix: The campaign names did not always display correctly in the campaign victory display.
[/list]

notes.title: Tank Battle: Normandy - version 3.0.2 update
notes.content:
Fix: Issue of an aircraft image sometimes appearing after selecting off board artillery.
Fix: Some button alignment issues.
Fix: Some spelling errors.

notes.title: Tank Battle: Normandy version 3.0.1 update
notes.content: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Tank Battle: Normandy v3.0.0 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Add: Weapon animations.
[*] Change: Improved computer player A.I.
[*] Change: Improved U.I.
[*] Change: The play balance in the 'Surrounded' mission.  After some A.I. changes it was too difficult.
[*] Change: Update the play balance in some other scenarios.
[*] Change: Reduction in the download size.
[*] Fix: Missing some mount/dismount buttons.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[*] Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
[*] Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievements
notes.content:
Achievements have now been added to Tank Battle Normandy.

Any issues let us know at support@hexwar.com

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fix: Pursuit campaign, convoy scenario the staff car could not cross the top bridge.
Fix: Some textual errors.

Any issues let us know at support@hexwar.com

notes.title: First Patch Released!
notes.content:
Good news everyone!

We've just released the first patch for Tank Battle Normandy.  This fixes a number of issues as well as introduces some UI improvements including:
[list]
[*] Fix crash on Windows where floating M4 Sherman's would crash on reaching the shoreline.
[*] Fix ability of infantry to enter pillboxes.
[*] Victory Condition triggering incorrectly in C4S1, 'Bombardment'.
[*] Fix off-map artillery displaying mount into transport button incorrectly.
[*] Add sliders to scrolling windows.
[/list]
We hope you're all enjoying the game, but if you've any problems, queries or suggestions, then please just let us know at support@hexwar.com.

~The HexWar Games Team
